title: Klevu pricing - Modular add-ons, Site Search from $649/month
clean_text: Klevu's Site Search plan starts at $649 per month including 50,000 search requests, available standalone or as part of a suite. Recommendations are sold as an add-on to Site Search starting at $449 per month for 500,000 impressions, with additional volume tiers available. Category Merchandising is priced at $549 per month for 250,000 category page views. A 14-day free trial is available on Shopify App Store listings.
